info.title: ProxCenter public API
info.description: API for external tooling, authenticated by a pxc_ service-account token. Reading and writing depend on the scopes granted to the token. Write operations act on the real infrastructure immediately. Server to server: no CORS header is emitted.

get.summary: List all VMs and containers across visible connections
get.description:
Aggregated VM/LXC list with status, usage and config-derived fields (cpuType, scsihw, agentEnabled, bios, ostype, onboot, description, macs) served by default. `ips` merges the addresses pinned in the config with the last known guest agent / LXC addresses from a background index; `staleIps` lists the last known addresses a guest could not re-confirm (stopped, agent down) and `ipIndexWarming` tells that the index is still being built. Pass include=agent to probe the QEMU guest agent on running VMs (about 7x slower).

Required scope: `vms:read`

post.description:
Applies micro-segmentation to the guest: enables its firewall, sets DROP policies, applies the base security groups of its networks (creating a missing one) and `additional_sgs`, and enables the firewall on its NICs, as the flags ask. {vmType} is qemu or lxc. Runs on the orchestrator only (no direct Proxmox fallback). Needs node.manage on the connection. A vDC tenant token reaches the guests of its own vDC pools only. `apply_base_sgs` is refused to a vDC tenant token (it may create cluster-level groups and aliases): 403.

Required scope: `firewall:write`

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: Raw connection id; must be inside the token connection perimeter.

schema.description: Only these fields, spelled exactly, are forwarded; another type than the one documented is refused 400.

apply_base_sgs.description: Apply the sg-base-* group of each guest network, creating a missing one (and its gw-* alias). Refused to a vDC tenant token: 403
